gloss: to take seriously; to believe (something said in jest)

definitions.gloss: to take seriously; to believe; to take at face value
definitions.explanation: To treat something said — often a joke, exaggeration, or casual remark — as if it were genuinely meant. Frequently used when someone mistakenly believes something that was not intended seriously.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{本気|ほんき}にするな。
⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{本気|ほんき}にしないで⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: I just said it offhandedly — don't take it seriously.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{本気|ほんき}→本気：03153_honki⟧ (seriousness, earnestness) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to treat as, to make into). The expression focuses on the listener's interpretation: treating something as serious or true.

USAGE:
Often used in the negative imperative {本気|ほんき}にするな / {本気|ほんき}にしないで (don't take it seriously). Distinct from ⟦{本気|ほんき}→本気：03153_honki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to get serious, to give it one's all), which is about one's own effort rather than interpreting someone else's words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{本気|ほんき}にする — to take a joke seriously
- {本気|ほんき}にしないで — don't take it seriously
- {本気|ほんき}にされる — to be taken seriously (passive)
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{本気|ほんき}にする — to believe a lie

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真|ま}に{受|う}ける→真に受ける：19010_maniukeru⟧ — to take at face value (very similar; slightly more formal)
- ⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧ — to believe (neutral; broader usage)
- ⟦{本気|ほんき}→本気：03153_honki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ — to get serious, to give it one's all (different meaning: about effort, not belief)
